package: Lead Response for home service businesses

placeholders.__WF_ERROR__: id of the imported 'Core 0: Error Handler'
placeholders.__WF_SENDSMS__: id of the imported 'Core 1: Send SMS'
placeholders.__WF_ALERT__: id of the imported 'Core 3: Owner Alert'
placeholders.__OWNER_CELL__: the business owner mobile number in E.164, e.g. +15551234567
placeholders.__BUSINESS_NUMBER__: the Twilio number customers text and call, in E.164
placeholders.__OWNER_EMAIL__: the email address owner alerts fall back to
